decisions: Username, story collectibles, empty profile shells and transparent business/creator pages can become transferable assets.
Wallets, private keys, private messages, KYC/KYB, earned sigils, sanctions, dating history and personal reputation are non-transferable.
Story UX should use a prism-chain tap-to-peek interaction before full-screen open.
Private access keeps the 1 USD stablecoin-equivalent minimum and 90/10 creator/Nexus split already defined for private content.
A transferred page or username does not transfer hidden trust; owner changes are labelled and ranking enters anti-fraud cooldown.
constraints: No real payments implemented in this packet.
No external provider or paid API used.
Production rollout requires legal terms, country capability matrix, age gates where relevant, anti-wash controls and smart-contract audit.
